title: The April Laws of 1848 and Parliamentary Government
grammar: Conformity and compliance: összhangban and megfelelően ('in accordance with / in conformity with')
goal: I can describe the constitutional shift brought about by the 1848 April Laws.
I can use összhangban and megfelelően to express regulatory compliance and statutory alignment.
I can articulate concepts such as parliamentary responsibility, popular representation, and civil equality.
